# ScopeSite Digital Studios

> Veteran-owned, AI-first web design agency based in Somerset, UK. We specialize in making businesses visible to AI platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity through our proprietary V.O.I.C.E™ methodology.

## About Us

- Company: ScopeSite Digital Studios
- Location: Frome, Somerset, UK
- Founded by: Dan Cartwright (British Army Veteran)
- Specialization: AI-optimized web design, V.O.I.C.E™ AI visibility optimization
- Target Market: UK SMEs, service businesses

## Services

- Web Design: Server-side rendered (SSR) websites built on Next.js for maximum AI crawler visibility
- AI Website Design: Websites engineered for ChatGPT, voice search, and AI platform recommendations
- AI SEO Services: Getting businesses recommended by AI using the V.O.I.C.E™ methodology
- Schema Markup: Professional JSON-LD implementation with 100% validation guarantee
- V.O.I.C.E™ Optimization: Proprietary methodology for AI platform visibility (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI)
- Custom Web Apps: Bespoke business applications, quote builders, client portals

## Service Areas

We serve businesses across Somerset and the South West:

- Somerset: Frome (home base), Taunton, Yeovil, Bridgwater, Glastonbury, Wells, Shepton Mallet
- Bath: City Centre, Lansdown, Widcombe, Keynsham, Midsomer Norton, Bradford-on-Avon
- Bristol: City Centre, Clifton, Harbourside, Redcliffe, Bedminster, Filton, Portishead

## V.O.I.C.E™ Methodology

Our proprietary framework for AI visibility:

- Visibility: Making your business findable by AI assistants like ChatGPT, Siri, Alexa and Claude
- Optimisation: Technical improvements to structured data, schema markup and site architecture
- Intelligent: AI-focused strategy that goes beyond traditional SEO
- Conversational: Voice search ready - optimised for how people actually talk to AI
- Engines: Built for ChatGPT, Siri, Alexa, Claude, Perplexity and whatever comes next
